result.topic_en: Brief pencil notes, with a small sketch of descending lines on axes, giving spherical-trigonometry relations among an angle i, d, δ and the difference (α − a), followed by inequality comparisons; the rest of the sheet shows only faint bleed-through from the reverse side.
result.transcription:
$(90^\circ-(\alpha-a))$ [-$\cos d$-] [-$\mathrm{tg}\,d$-] {+$\cot d$+} $=\cos i\,\cot(\alpha-a)$
$\cos i=\mathrm{tg}\,d\;\mathrm{tg}(\alpha-a)>\cos d$
$\cot i=\cos(\alpha-a)\cot d>\cot\delta$
$\frac{\cot\delta\cdot\cos(\alpha-a)}{\cot d}>1$

methods.what: Spherical-trigonometry relation linking cot d, cos i and cot(α−a), written next to the angle 90°−(α−a)
The same relation solved for cos i, with an inequality against cos d
Relation for cot i in terms of cos(α−a) and cot d, compared with cot δ
Inequality condition written as a ratio

items.english: cos i = tan d · tan(α − a), which is greater than cos d
cot i = cos(α − a) · cot d, which is greater than cot δ
cot δ · cos(α − a) divided by cot d is greater than 1
